HidrateSpark Health Sync requests write-only access to hydration. It downloads sip time and volume from the Home Assistant server you configure and writes those records to Health Connect. It does not read other health data, use analytics, or send health data to any third party. Your Home Assistant token is encrypted using the Android Keystore.
